newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ Nov futures end up, back months weaker.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ Nov futures end up, back months weaker.

text.p: NYCE November frozen concentrated orange juice futures clung to recent gains to end firmer on options-related interest, floor sources said.
The back months finished the thinly-traded session weaker.
"Most people are waiting to see what's going on with the report," one trader said in reference to the U.S. Department of Agriculture's estimate for the Florida crop, released October 11.
The last trading day for November FCOJ options is Friday, October 4. Analysts expected the November futures contract to migrate towards 115.00, a heavily-traded strike price in the contract.
Indeed, the contract closed at 115.15, up 1.45, having ranged from 115.25 to 112.50. The back months settled 1.70 to 1.15 lower.
